text: in the lower-load condition. Results showed almost identical hypertrophy of both the elbow flexors and quadriceps for the 40%, 60%, and 80% of 1RM conditions. However, muscle growth in the 20% condition was less than half that observed with the heavier loads. Taken together with research showing that similar increases in muscle size are obtained with 30% versus 80% of 1RM (153), the findings indicate that an intensity of 30% of 1RM may be a minimum loading threshold for hypertrophy training, below which muscle growth becomes compromised.
